detailZones.title: Monitor and arm
detailZones.description: Inspect the blank monitor, its bezel, the two joints on the support arm and its base plate.

detailZones.title: Desktop inputs and dock
detailZones.translation: 桌面输入设备与扩展坞
detailZones.description: Follow the blank laptop, docking station, keyboard, keypad, mouse, document holder and desk accessories.

detailZones.title: Desk surface and storage
detailZones.description: Inspect the work surface, rounded edges, desk legs, modesty panel and closed drawer pedestal.

detailZones.title: Chair and ergonomics
detailZones.translation: 办公椅与人体工学部件
detailZones.description: Explore the mesh task chair, lumbar support, armrests, adjustment hardware, five-star base and casters.

detailZones.title: Under-desk cables and power
detailZones.description: Follow the cable basket beneath the desk, the clips along its back and the cable riser down to the floor box.

detailZones.title: Room lighting and floor
detailZones.description: Explore the window, fabric divider, potted plant, recycling bin and the edge of the carpet.

anchorAudit.rationale: The mouse and pad, monitor glass and bezel, drawer handles and task lamp have distinct locations in the reviewed photograph. 91 photographed objects and parts remain pointable. 59 terms are available in the index only, including the hidden monitor rear housing and the coat stand previously placed on hanging headphones. Eight unrelated entries were excluded in the original audit.
